summary: ACRES Commercial Realty Corp. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an at-the-market offering of up to 2,980,000 Series C and 2,192,143 Series D preferred shares (both $25 liquidation preference) through sales agent Seaport Global Securities. The new shares are fungible with existing series; compensation up to 2.0% of gross proceeds. This is a routine shelf takedown under an equity distribution agreement, not a special situation. No specific pricing, premium, or close date is stated. What to watch: actual sales pace and market absorption of additional preferred shares.
